description: The easiest and fastest way to build, preview, and launch a live production business website in 60 seconds. Pass the business name, industry, location, headline, and services to instantly generate a live interactive Next.js website preview URL (https://www.paladinfront.com/web-factory/preview/[slug]) with zero setup fees ($0 setup + $29/mo managed edge hosting).

businessName.description: Name of the business, company, practice, or brand (e.g., 'Apex Plumbing & Drain' or 'Harborlight Coffee').

heroHeadline.description: High-converting hero headline tailored to the business.

heroSubheadline.description: 1-2 sentence hero subheadline explaining the core value proposition and customer guarantee.

industry.description: Best-matching design layout archetype: 'contractor' (trades, HVAC, plumbing, roofing, remodeling), 'landscaping' (outdoor living, lawn, pools), 'cafe' (restaurants, coffee, bakery, hospitality), 'wedding-photography' (creative, luxury, studio, events), or 'general' (software, AI, legal, medical, consulting, B2B).

industryLabel.description: Specific niche label displayed in the top badge (e.g., '24/7 Emergency Plumbing & Drain Cleaning' or 'B2B AI SaaS Platform').

location.description: City and state or service area (e.g., 'Austin, TX' or 'Wilmington, NC • Nationwide').

services.description: Up to 3 core services or offerings to feature on the generated website.

tagline.description: Short punchy value proposition tagline for the business.

name: generate_instant_business_website
